promotion_review.review_note: Approved first expanded TUI read surface from full compile-time evidence. Deferred parameterized, HTML/HTMX, debug, and operation-like GET endpoints.
approved_policy: No path placeholders such as <pk> or <asset_code>.
Returns JSON-compatible business data in same-process smoke checks.
No refresh, activate, import, fetch, clear-cache, generate, or write-like verb in endpoint.
Risk remains read or ai for the ordinary TUI catalog.
deferred_examples: /api/dashboard/attention-items/ returns HTMX HTML, not a business view model.
/api/data-center/market-thermometer/history/ currently raises NameError in the API view.
Account and portfolio endpoints need explicit field metadata and permission UX before promotion.
Parameterized endpoints need TUI field controls before promotion.
